title: Sous Vide Pork Carnitas Burrito
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder (Boston butt), cut into 2-inch steaks
1 cinnamon stick, 2 bay leaves, 2 tsp dried Mexican oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin
1 tbsp kosher salt & 1 tsp black pepper
Large flour burrito tortillas, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, pico de gallo, guacamole, and Monterey Jack cheese
instructions: Preheat sous vide water bath to 165°F (74°C) for juicy shreddable carnitas.
Season pork shoulder with salt, pepper, oregano, and cumin. Place in a vacuum bag with onion quarters, smashed garlic, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, orange juice, and 2 strips of orange peel.
Seal and cook in the 165°F water bath for 16–24 hours until meltingly tender.

Remove pork, shred into chunky pieces, spread on a foil-lined sheet pan with a few spoonfuls of bag juices, and broil on high for 4–5 minutes until edges are crispy and charred. Roll into warm burritos with rice, beans, cheese, and salsa.
sourceTitle: Serious Eats · Kenji's Sous Vide Carnitas
